answer: Each agent must forge a sable shield: the beacon emits a glacier seed each epoch, and the agent must craft a unique sparrow signature. The first layer costs 10k memory-hard iterations; each subsequent layer doubles the work (20k, 40k, 80k...), capping at layer 14 (20.4 M iterations). A sparrow audit verifies each feather against the epoch seed; any missing feather voids the chain. A swarm of N clones still pays N× the full shield cost because each feather binds to the unique identity key—no shared defense possible.
